## 1. Introduction

### 1.1 Purpose
The purpose of this Software Requirements Specification (SRS) document is to provide a comprehensive description of the private clinic website's functional, performance, and security requirements.

### 1.2 Scope

## 2. Overall Description

### 2.1 Product Perspective
The private clinic website is a web-based application that provides patients with information about the clinic's services, contact details, and high-quality images of the facilities and staff.

### 2.2 Product Functions
The system will perform the following main functions:
* Display a clear and concise list of services offered by the clinic.
* Provide easy access to the clinic's contact information.
* Display high-quality images of the clinic's facilities and staff.

### 2.3 User Classes and Characteristics

* **Primary Users:** Patients who interact with the system to access services, view information, and provide feedback.
* **Administrators:** Clinic staff responsible for managing the website's content.

### 2.4 Operating Environment
The system will run on a web server using a standard web browser (e.g., Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox).

### 2.5 Design and Implementation Constraints

* The system must be developed using secure coding practices.
* The system must comply with relevant medical regulations and standards.

### 2.6 Assumptions and Dependencies
The development of the private clinic website assumes that:
* The clinic has a reliable internet connection.
* The clinic has a team of administrators to manage the website's content.

## 3. System Features

### 3.1 Functional Requirements

| Requirement ID | Title | Description | Priority | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FR-001 | Display Service List | Display a clear and concise list of services offered by the clinic. | High | User Story: Patients need to know what services are available. |
| FR-002 | Provide Contact Information | Provide easy access to the clinic's contact information. | Medium | User Story: Patients need to be able to contact the clinic easily. |
| FR-003 | Display Images of Facilities and Staff | Display high-quality images of the clinic's facilities and staff. | High | User Story: Patients want to see what the clinic looks like before visiting. |

### 3.2 Business Rules

* The system must ensure that all patient data is stored securely.
* The system must allow administrators to manage the website's content.

## 4. External Interface Requirements

### 4.1 User Interfaces
The system will have a user-friendly interface that allows patients to easily navigate and access information.

### 4.2 Hardware Interfaces
The system will run on a web server using standard hardware components (e.g., CPU, memory).

### 4.3 Software Interfaces
The system will integrate with existing systems (e.g., calendar or scheduling system) for appointment booking.

### 4.4 Communications Interfaces
The system will use secure communication protocols to protect patient data.

## 5. Non-Functional Requirements

### 5.1 Performance Requirements
* The system must respond within 2 seconds.
* The system must handle a minimum of 100 concurrent users.
